decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2017.02.1491-00, 2017.02.1491-01, 2017.02.1491-02- Received: 5 March 2018
2017.02.1491-07 Rev. E, 2017.02.1491-04 Rev. E, 2017.02.1491-03 Rev. E, 2017.02.1491-06 Rev. E, 2017.02.1491-05 Rev. E - Received: 17 April 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed and non-openable up to atleast 1.7m from internal floor level and shall be hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the roof extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and a side roof extension with two front roof windows to the house.
